newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money market lively on high demand.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money market lively on high demand.

text.p: The Croatian money market picked up on Tuesday due to swollen demand as most banks' accounts were depleted during the holidays.

Dealers said settlements totalled 68 million kuna worth of fresh loans. Most trading was made at the call money rate which was steady at 11 percent and two smaller long-term deals were struck at 17 and 15 percent.
Overnight trade at the weekend totalled 22 million kuna that went to four banks with shortfalls, and one used the funds for its mandatory reserves, dealers said.
